[media]
# Play as a human recruit fighting alongside the Autobots in an arcade-style, on-rails VR shooter set in the Transformers universe.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
**Fight alongside Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, and Grimlock as they battle Megatron and the Decepticons across Earth and Cybertron.**

Blast through powerful enemy forces, unlock new abilities, take on towering bosses, and help save Earth from destruction.

🗨️ **Join Our Discord Community for More** 👉 https://discord.gg/ZPT2a8St72

[media]
**Battle Legendary Decepticons**

Take on powerful Decepticon commanders as each battle pushes you deeper into the war for Earth.

[media]
**Arcade Shooter Action**

Inspired by classic arcade shooters, dodge incoming attacks, unleash powerful weapons, and carve a path through the Decepticon forces. 

**Journey Beyond Earth**

Leave Earth behind and experience the home world of the Transformers for yourself.
